records.title: PlanTwin: Privacy-Preserving Planning Abstractions for Cloud-Assisted LLM Agents
records.reason: The abstract describes privacy-preserving projection of private environment state for cloud-agent planning; its contribution is disclosure control and privacy guarantees, not inference resource reduction.

records.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Text Embedding Interpolation for Continuous Image Steering
records.reason: The primary paper applies text-embedding interpolation to steer text-conditioned image generation; the LLM is used to construct prompt pairs, not as an inference system being optimized.

records.title: GIST: Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformers for Scalable Graph Neural Operators
records.reason: The abstract concerns graph neural operators over meshes and graph benchmarks, with no connection to LLM inference or serving.

records.title: RAZOR: Ratio-Aware Layer Editing for Targeted Unlearning in Vision Transformers and Diffusion Models
records.reason: The primary paper targets parameter/head editing for machine unlearning on vision/diffusion models. Its efficiency claim concerns unlearning operations, not LLM inference, and the full text provides no decoding, serving, or inference-memory technique despite the quantization lineage link.

records.title: VAREX: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Structured Extraction from Documents
records.reason: The abstract presents a benchmark for multimodal extraction from government-form documents; model-size evaluation is contextual, not an inference optimization technique.
